Polling Places

(subject to change: must be set at least 40 days prior to an election)

Polls Open 7 am to 7 pm

Ward 1

Location: Mater Christi School, 50 Mansfield Avenue

Ward 2

Location: Integrated Arts Academy/ H.O. Wheeler, 6 Archibald Street

Ward 3

Location: Sustainability Academy/Lawrence Barnes Elementary School, 123 North Street

Ward 4

Location: Burlington High School, 110 Seahorse Street. ***This is a new location for the November 2026 election.

Ward 5

Location: Burlington Electric Department, 585 Pine Street

Ward 6

Location: Edmunds Elementary School, 299 Main Street 

Note: This polling place has moved from the Middle School Gym to the Elementary School Gym. Voter parking for space is available on Main Street using the bagged meter spaces or the small parking lot in front of the entrance. This polling place entrance is now on the Main Street side of the building for all voters.

Ward 7

Location: Robert Miller Recreation Center, 130 Gosse Court

Ward 8

Location: Fletcher Free Library, 235 College Street
